flash_697889.description:
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) said it received a report that a tanker was struck by an "unidentified projectile" off the coast of Oman yesterday while attempting to transit the Strait of Hormuz.

According to the report, no crew members were injured. The extent of the damage to the tanker and the environmental impact of the incident are still being assessed.

flash_697888.description: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani defends his October 7 post accusing Israel of genocide, arguing that the anniversary should acknowledge the impact of the war in Gaza.

flash_697887.description: Extremist haredi protesters block MK Meir Porush's car in Jerusalem, but his driver manages to leave the scene shortly afterward.

flash_697913.description: A Jewish state that depends on Arabs for its survival will not be Jewish or a state for long, but there may be way out of the coalition woes. Opinion.

flash_697912.description: Tourette syndrome primarily affects children and teenagers, and no cure has yet been found. A newly developed device is succeeding in stopping involuntary movements.

flash_697910.description: Anti-Israel activists protest Yoav Gallant's appearance at a Manhattan security event, demanding his arrest over alleged war crimes in Gaza.

flash_697908.description: Meeting between Trump and Putin concludes after 40 minutes

flash_697904.description: A ladder to the heavens and a House of G-d on Earth: Yaakov discovers the wages of deception.

flash_697902.description: US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin met in Shenzhen, China, ahead of a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

flash_697901.description: Former New York Assemblyman Dov Hikind calls on Jews to boycott Mayor Zohran Mamdani's Hanukkah celebration, citing the mayor's refusal to attend the Israel Day Parade.

flash_697899.description: Heavy rain causes the roof of a Florida synagogue to collapse, leaving its sanctuary unsafe, but a rabbi manages to rescue a Torah that survived the Holocaust.

flash_697897.description: Netanyahu is reportedly urging Trump to join a new military campaign against Iran lasting up to seven days, as Washington weighs intelligence and military options.

flash_697895.description: Trump on a possible deal with Iran: We have to have a lasting deal

flash_697893.description: Trump says Iran may be pursuing biological and chemical weapons but urges Americans not to panic over reports of a possible attack on Washington.

flash_697891.description: Hundreds of Vizhnitz Hasidim visit Joseph's Tomb to pray for the recovery of their Rebbe, a senior member of Agudat Yisrael's Council of Torah Sages.

flash_697983.description: A young Israeli collapsed while showering during the Annapurna trek in Nepal and died following exposure to gas. The Chabad House issued a warning to travelers in the area.

flash_697982.description: The mayor of Kfar Saba sent a relative to fetch his tefillin bag from his office. An inspection revealed watches inside, including a Rolex.

flash_697980.description: Combat engineer Osher Avraham, 19, of Rehovot, was found dead in his room at a northern base on Friday.

flash_697978.description: Kirsten Schwalbe, 112, reportedly served in leadership positions within Denmark's Nazi Party during World War II, despite previously claiming she had little interest in politics.

flash_697976.description: Acting on intelligence, Jerusalem-area Border Police stopped a suspicious car at the a-Za'ayyem crossing and found two illegal residents from Jenin hidden in its trunk. The driver, an Ashkelon resident in his 20s, was arrested along with them.

flash_697974.description: Gamal Sadat recalls his father's historic decision to make peace with Israel, the personal price he paid, and his enduring belief that courageous leaders can bring reconciliation to the Middle East.

flash_697972.description: Following repeated complaints about excessive noise from a mosque in Tel Sheva, police disconnected the loudspeakers and confiscated the amplification equipment.

flash_697970.description: The Eisenkot bloc's parties have nominated retired Supreme Court Justice Yosef Elron for state comptroller after the High Court voided the previous election and its winner, coalition nominee Michael Rabilo, withdrew his candidacy.

flash_697968.description: MK Rothman pledges a determined fight against opposition moves to repeal the judicial reform, saying the committees pursuing the repeal are part of a campaign for the next election.

flash_697966.description: A confrontation broke out between Joint List MK Hassan al-Nasasra and a police officer after the lawmaker said he saw officers beating and humiliating a handcuffed detainee by the roadside.

flash_697964.description: A 37-year-old suspect allegedly punched a Jewish man wearing a kippah after questioning him about his religion and Zionism. The suspect was already facing charges in two separate assault cases.

flash_697962.description: Archaeological excavations at the former Nazi concentration camp uncover ash, bone fragments, and the foundations of SS guard dog kennels, shedding new light on the camp's operations.

flash_697960.description: Muslim Zionist advocate Sara Zoabi criticizes Arab MKs who left the plenum during "Hatikvah". Speaking to Arutz Sheva, she explains why she proudly sings the anthem and reveals the steep personal cost of her views, even among those close to her.

flash_697958.description: Haredi factions are planning to block off the major traffic artery after a man was arrested while dropping off relatives at the airport.

flash_697957.description: A haredi deserter from Rishon Lezion was arrested at his home overnight. His detention sentence extends beyond his wedding date, scheduled for less than two weeks from now.

flash_697956.description: US, UK, France, and Germany demand Iran restore IAEA access, warning that its enriched uranium stockpile remains unverified amid nuclear concerns.

flash_698013.description: A new Philadelphia museum exhibit explores how Caribbean Jews helped secure American independence while building thriving Jewish communities in the region.

flash_698012.description: Lod resident arrested after allegedly hitting a police officer, ramming vehicles, and driving against traffic. Police open fire on his vehicle, leaving him seriously injured.

flash_698011.description: Singer, composer, and arranger Kobi Recht has died at 79. Over a career spanning decades, he contributed to numerous Israeli songs, musical groups, and films.

flash_698009.description: An international exhibition at Chipping Barnet Library tells the stories of Holocaust survivors and those who risked their lives to save Jews from Nazi persecution.

flash_698007.description: The British government is continuing to perpetuate a truly infernal legacy. Opinion.

flash_698005.description: Israeli researchers develop experimental blood test that detects early-stage breast cancer with 95% accuracy and could help predict the risk of recurrence.

flash_698003.description: Claude AI chatbot developer Anthropic jumped 18% in its Nasdaq debut after raising $81.3 billion in the largest IPO in history. Shares were priced at $83, above the original range, valuing the company at about $1.5 trillion.

flash_698001.description: Kvutzat Yavne Food Products has recalled size 7-9 cucumbers in brine after a consumer reported a foreign metal object in one item. Consumers who purchased products from the affected batch are asked not to consume them and to contact customer service.

flash_697999.description: At MK Elisha Medan's Knesset unity tent, Israel Prize winner Menachem Kalmanson and father Rabbi Benny urged Netanyahu-Eisenkot unity: "In my son Elhanan's name, who gave his life, in his children's name, in the Jewish people's name".

flash_697997.description: The young man who was critically injured in a shooting incident in Jaffa has been pronounced dead. He was previously taken to the hospital while undergoing CPR.

flash_697995.description: Jacob’s dream of seeing angels came true - but only on his way back to Israel.

flash_697993.description:
Firefighters rescued three people trapped in a five-vehicle car accident on Highway 505 in Samaria.

The forces used specialized rescue tools and conducted scans to rule out the presence of additional wounded.

flash_697991.description:
A short while ago, the Israeli Air Force conducted a strike, guided by precise intelligence, in the Janta area in the Beqaa region of Lebanon, targeting a site that was previously used by the Hezbollah terrorist organization for missile production and the storage of weapons.

The site was struck by the IDF several times during the war. The IDF identified that Hezbollah terrorists had arrived at the site recently and struck the site's entrances in order to prevent its restoration.

flash_697990.description: Netanyahu associates and opposition figures are exploring a unity government plan: Netanyahu would serve first as PM in a rotation, then step aside to run for president. Moving up the presidential election through legislation is being considered.

flash_697988.description: Israel Antiquities Authority inspectors caught six suspects digging inside a 2,000-year-old archaeological site in the Judean Hills. Authorities say the search for hidden treasure caused irreversible damage.

flash_697986.description: As Yaakov Avinu understood at Beit El, the Land, the people and our relationship with Hashem belong together.

flash_697984.description: Haredi analyst Yisrael Cohen tells Arutz Sheva about UTJ-Eisenkot bloc talks: Conscription demands remain far from opposition positions, but a Liberman plan could enable a deal, amid fears UTJ could be left out of government.

flash_698031.description: The term “Islamophobia" itself is a misnomer. And in this proposed bill prohibiting it, speech about Muslim perpetrators of hate crimes against Jews, Christians and others would be chilled, among other things. Opinion.

flash_698030.description: An 80-year-old man died in an apartment fire in Rosh Pina, while his wife suffered moderate injuries. Hours earlier, seven people were injured in another fire in northern Israel.

flash_698029.description: Iranian-run accounts posing as French build their audience with images of Gaza, then turn that against French society itself. Opinion.

flash_698027.description: Why is the ideal of Mizmor Shir especially fitting for a psalm celebrating the Temple’s dedication?

flash_698025.description:
The Portland Trail Blazers defeated the Milwaukee Bucks 124-114 on the road on Thursday night, without Deni Avdija, who missed his second consecutive game due to injury.

Damian Lillard led Portland with 33 points and six rebounds. The Trail Blazers will visit the New York Knicks at Madison Square Garden on Saturday night, hoping Avdija will be able to return to action.

flash_698023.description: Santee City Council unanimously adopts the IHRA definition of antisemitism, joining other San Diego County cities amid concerns over anti-Jewish incidents.

flash_698021.description:
Police responded overnight to the clashes in Beit Shemesh, announcing that they would take legal action against those involved in the violence.

In a statement, police said, "A violent and agitated mob was used by the minor, who exploited it in a failed attempt to evade justice. Assaults and violence of any kind against police officers are serious offenses that we will not tolerate. Enforcement action will be taken in accordance with the law against the minor and the rioters as part of an investigation that has been launched."

flash_698020.description: Pentagon officials estimate the Iran war has cost $48.3 billion, excluding damage to US bases, as lawmakers demand answers about the conflict's growing price tag.

flash_698018.description:
White House National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross is leaving his position, Axios reported.

According to two sources familiar with the matter, Cairncross did not want to remain in the role for another two years and decided to step down now to allow the White House to complete the Senate confirmation process for his successor before Democrats take control of the chamber in January.

flash_698017.description: Amit Segal reports that the Knesset Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee's legal adviser opposes the emerging draft plan. Liberman denies the report: "There is no Liberman plan."

flash_698015.description: Iran rejects US claims about possible chemical and biological weapons development, accusing Washington of repeating the intelligence failures preceding the Iraq war.

flash_698010.description: Trump tells Axios he will wait until the new year to decide on further action against Iran, amid Israeli pressure for strikes and concerns over Tehran's retaliation.

flash_698008.description:
The police are searching for Shalom Dover Yosef, 10 years old from Tel Zion, who was last seen today at 6:00 PM in the town.

He is about 1.20 meters tall, has dark brown hair with sidelocks, and was wearing black clothes and a kippah with the inscription "Shabbat Moshiach." Anyone with information about his whereabouts is asked to call hotline 100.

שלום דובער יוסףצילום: דוברות המשטרה

flash_698006.description: Association of Jewish Refugees chairman Mike Karp and chief executive Michael Newman receive Austrian state honors for supporting Holocaust survivors and preserving their legacy.

flash_698004.description: Families who moved into purchased homes on the outskirts of Jericho describe their historic move, extensive preparations, and plans to expand Jewish settlement in the area.

flash_698002.description: Israeli Air Force strikes entrances to a Hezbollah weapons facility in Lebanon's Beqaa Valley after terrorists were spotted returning to the site in an apparent attempt to restore it.

flash_698081.description: Yashar leader says coalition talks cannot continue indefinitely, sharply criticizes Netanyahu and warns against missing a chance to replace the government. If talks on a broad government fail, he plans to form a national emergency government.

flash_698080.description: During a live Lebanese TV broadcast, Christian commentator Charles Jabbour wears a kippah bearing a Star of David and the name of the Israeli series Fauda.

flash_698079.description:
Amid efforts to form a government with the support of the Arab parties, MK Sharon Sharabi (Yisrael Beytenu) made clear that he would not support such a move.

"I stand by my promise and will continue to uphold it: I will not be part of a coalition that relies on supporters of terrorism, whether from within or from outside. Some principles are non-negotiable, and some values cannot be compromised," he declared.

flash_698078.description:
Yashar party chairman Gadi Eisenkot announced that if efforts to form a broad government fail, he will move to establish a national emergency government.

"This is not a threat for negotiating purposes. It is a decision I have made based on my understanding of the responsibility and duties entrusted to me at this time of emergency," he said.

Eisenkot added that he intends to present a new government to the Knesset for approval at the appropriate time.

flash_698076.description: Iranian adviser Mohammad Mokhber claims Trump's summit with Xi and Putin weakened US influence, while insisting Hormuz remains a red line for Tehran.

flash_698074.description: CBS News: Israel and US considering new assault on Iran in short term

flash_698072.description: Iraqi forces take control of positions held by Kataib Hezbollah in Jurf al-Sakhar after a tense standoff, with roads set to reopen to civilians.

flash_698070.description: We can address an injustice without allowing resentment to dictate our lives, for example.

flash_698068.description: It is not prosperity that Hosea condemns. It is the response to it.

flash_698066.description: The Houthi terrorist rebels in Yemen have issued a statement warning aviation companies that Saudi airspace is unsafe, as it will become a theater for their operations in the coming hours. The terror group noted that "the sacred airspace over Mecca and Medina" is not included in the warning.

flash_698064.description: The struggles within Yaakov's young family are mirrrored in our young state's history. With maturity, come the recognition and understanding that we must live together, despite differences of opinion and roles.

flash_698062.description: Doron Sanders, president of the Mizrachi movement in the Netherlands, tells Arutz Sheva that growing antisemitism is prompting some Jews to conceal their identity, while others are considering immigrating to Israel.

flash_698060.description: Five months after Staff Sgt. Nave Habshoosh fell in southern Lebanon, his mother gave birth to a daughter. President Herzog called to congratulate the parents, Haim and Einav, whom he had also comforted during the week of shiva.

flash_698058.description: Combat engineer Osher Avraham, found dead at a northern base, will be buried Sunday. After a legal battle and meeting with the forensic institute's director, his family says it has some answers and will keep seeking clarity on his death.

flash_698056.description: Right-wing commentator Hadar Miller slams MK Ahmad Tibi over his refusal to condemn Hamas as a terrorist organization, says Israeli society suffering from moral confusion.

flash_698054.description: MK Jabareen accused the attorney general of allowing incitement against his party and the use of the term "terror supporters". Likud: These are the people the left-wing bloc is joining forces with.

flash_698052.description: According to Bloomberg, Israel has expanded the air defense system's capabilities to counter ballistic threats, amid a need for cheaper interceptors as stockpiles are depleted during the fighting.

flash_629916.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat in North America, where they are being written now.

Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 17:16 Jerusalem time.

Shabbat Shalom!

flash_698088.description:
Netanyahu reportedly demands that no state inquiry into October 7 be established during a unity government's term, as talks with Eisenkot address a possible rotation deal.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_698086.description:
IDF strikes Hamas terrorists meeting in central Gaza to plan attacks against Israelis.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_698084.description:
Trump vows to prevent Iran from developing a radioactive dirty bomb following reports of a possible threat to Washington, while US officials rule out an imminent attack.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_698082.description:
Trump says Iran is seeking an agreement with Washington but refuses to accept its terms, as reports suggest the US and Israel are considering renewed strikes.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_698077.description: Additional officers from the Royal Moroccan Army have arrived to participate in the International Stabilization Force in Gaza. According to the ISF, the officers will add capacity to medical operations and logistics planning.

flash_698075.description: CBS News reports that Israel and the US are considering fresh strikes on Iran as Tehran rebuilds its missiles and Trump weighs military action.

flash_698071.description: IDF and Shin Bet eliminate senior Hamas and Islamic Jihad Nukhba operatives, including an October 7 infiltrator, in strikes across the Gaza Strip.

flash_698069.description:
IDF, Border Police, and Judea and Samaria District Police forces confiscated approximately 15 drones across Judea and Samaria over the past week as part of a targeted operation to prevent the use of drones for terrorist purposes, including carrying and dropping explosives.

According to the IDF Spokesperson's Unit, more than 500 drones have been confiscated in the area since the beginning of 2026.

The IDF noted that the possession and operation of drones are prohibited in the area under an order issued by the IDF Central Command chief, and that efforts to counter the threat are ongoing.

flash_698067.description: Saudi led coalition issues evacuation warning for Houthi-controlled port of Hodeida

flash_698065.description: The PM said he recently briefed Liberman, Bennett and Eisenkot on security and urged a unity government. He opposed a minority government backed by Arab parties, "It's inconceivable. Every hour we wait is an hour wasted".

flash_698063.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addressed the security and political situation, saying: "We are at a historic crossroads. I briefed Lieberman and Eisenkot on the security situation. Responsibility means unity."

Netanyahu also addressed the possibility of forming a minority government, saying: "I hear that there is an intention to swear in a minority government as early as the beginning of next week. It is inconceivable."

flash_698061.description: Israir passengers will gain access to hundreds of destinations across the Americas through a new agreement with American Airlines, which plans to resume direct flights to Israel in March 2027.

flash_698087.description:
Vice President JD Vance asked whether the war in Iran was worth the Republican midterm losses, stresses his support for the president's policy.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_698085.description:
Ahmad Yaqoub, who led the terrorist cell behind a 2024 bombing near the Gilboa security barrier, surrenderד following weeks of IDF operations to capture him.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_698083.description:
IDF Spokesperson Effie Defrin says the military remains prepared for defensive and offensive scenarios, but public safety guidelines remain unchanged amid Iran reports.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_227155.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' Israel desk is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of Shabbat. Jerusalem candle lighting time is 15:58 on Friday. Our North American desk will keep you informed until the 16:16 EST candle lighting time in New York.

The updates from Israel will resume Saturday night, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 17:16 in Jerusalem.

Shabbat Shalom!

flash_698073.description: Drawing on lessons from three years of war, the 401st Brigade's technology and maintenance teams practiced rescuing trapped soldiers, recovering damaged combat vehicles, and responding to battlefield emergencies.
